dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 23, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Cardinals Cruise, Astros Shut Out Cubs: Recap of Tuesday's MLB Action"

The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, winning 8-1 behind a strong staff effort. Jordan Walker led the way for the Cardinals, hitting a home run and driving in three runs. Bryan Torres also homered in the victory. Meanwhile, the Houston Astros pitched a shutout against the Chicago Cubs, with Kai-Wei Teng striking out six in six innings. Christian Walker had a big day at the plate for the Astros, hitting two home runs.

In other action, the Toronto Blue Jays outscored the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, with Patrick Corbin pitching six strong innings and striking out seven. George Springer hit a home run for the Blue Jays. The Philadelphia Phillies blanked the Cleveland Guardians 3-0, with Zack Wheeler throwing six scoreless innings and striking out six. Bryce Harper walked in the win.

The Minnesota Twins edged the Boston Red Sox 4-2, with Taj Bradley pitching five scoreless innings and striking out seven. Trevor Larnach had four hits for the Twins. The Washington Nationals beat the Atlanta Braves 2-0, with Grant Holmes striking out 10 in five innings. Jorbit Vivas homered for the Nationals.
